pages.title: The Hollow Grove
pages.text: Somewhere in the Hollow, life took root anyway. Violet moss creeps over the pale stone, and crooked $(l)Hollow Trees$() lift flat, glowing canopies into the dark.$(br2)Spores drift in the air. It is the only place here that feels almost kind.

Hollow Trees drop $(l)saplings$() that grow on Hollow Grass, dirt or grass, in any world.$(br2)The Hollow is too dark for them to grow alone: use $(l)bone meal$() or $(l)Verdant Growth$(), or give them torchlight.

$(l)Hollow Grass$() spreads slowly across nearby End stone, and fades back to stone if covered. Break it and you get End stone; use $(l)Silk Touch$() to carry the grass itself.$(br2)$(l)Hollow Logs$() become $(l)Hollow Planks$(), which work in any recipe that takes planks.
